key.name: presets
key.description: Each preset is a name and a brightness in percent, applied to every monitor. A preset's contrast, if it has one, is in preset-contrast.

key.name: preset-contrast
key.description: Maps a preset's name to the contrast in percent it sets on every monitor. A preset not listed leaves contrast as it is.

key.name: schedule-enabled
key.description: When on, the extension applies each scheduled preset at its time, every day.

key.name: schedule
key.description: Each entry is a time in minutes after midnight (0 to 1439) and the name of the preset to apply then, sorted by time. Of two entries with the same time the first is used; an entry whose preset does not exist is skipped.

key.name: schedule-handled
key.description: Unix time of the last scheduled change that was applied or overridden by a preset picked by hand. On login, unlock and wake the current scheduled preset is applied only if its time is later than this.
